crossRefs.note: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Jehu the son of…
Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings…
Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city, and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Now the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
translations.bsb: As for the rest of the acts of Ahaz and all his ways, from beginning to end, they are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translations.kjv: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
translations.asv: Now the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
